ArgonTest.Name: Tuple record variable
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::*
record MyRecord value: String end
proc printTuple(a: MyRecord, b: MyRecord): () do puts a.value puts b.value end
proc main(): () do let tupleValue: (MyRecord, MyRecord) = MyRecord { value: "1" }, MyRecord { value: "2" } printTuple tupleValue end
